meta.title: Systagma — Custom software, integrations and data
meta.description: Software house that designs, builds and integrates web platforms, mobile apps and data solutions. From first sketch to measured impact.

hero.lead: Systagma designs, builds and integrates custom software, and measures what it delivers. From the first sketch to impact you can see in the data.
hero.note: We reply within one business day.

about.statement: Systagma comes from Greek: <g>systēma</g>, a whole made of parts, and <g>tagma</g>, something set in order.
about.followUp: That's our job. We arrange people, processes and data into software that works as a single system, and we show in numbers what changed.

services.h2: From code to outcome, in four moves.
services.lead: Every project moves through the same four stages. Bring us in for one, a few, or the whole way.

analyze.title: Analyze

how.lead: Three ways to start, with the same rules in each.

discovery.title: Discovery sprint
discovery.body: Two weeks to understand the problem, test the solution with the people who'll use it, and leave with a scope, a plan and an estimate. Fixed price.
discovery.bestFor: When the idea is still open.

fixed.title: Fixed-scope project
fixed.body: Scope, timeline and budget agreed before we start, with deliveries every two weeks.
fixed.bestFor: MVPs and systems with a clear goal.

team.title: Dedicated team
team.body: A cross-functional team that works as an extension of yours, in two-week cycles, on the priorities you set.

code.title: You own the code.
code.body: Repositories, cloud accounts and documentation are in your company's name from day one.

demos.title: Working software every two weeks.
demos.body: You see demos, not status reports.

metrics.title: Metrics before features.
metrics.body: We agree on how success is measured before the first line of code.

writing.title: Price and timeline in writing.
writing.body: Scope changes are estimated and approved before they enter a cycle.

faq.lead: What people usually ask before we start.

faq-custo.q: How much does a project cost?
faq-custo.a: It depends on scope and format. After a first conversation we send a written proposal with scope, timeline and budget. When the scope is still open, we start with a two-week, fixed-price discovery sprint.

faq-prazo.a: An MVP usually takes 8 to 16 weeks. The exact timeline is in the proposal, with deliveries every two weeks so you can follow along.

faq-codigo.a: Your company. Repositories, cloud accounts, domains and documentation are in your name from the start, and we hand everything over in order when the contract ends.

faq-sistema.q: Can you take over a system that's already running?
faq-sistema.a: Yes. We start with a technical audit of the code, infrastructure and risks, and only then propose a plan.

faq-ideia.q: Do I need everything figured out?
faq-ideia.a: No. An idea or a clearly described problem is enough for a first conversation. The discovery sprint exists to turn that into scope.

faq-comunicacao.a: A direct channel with the team (email, Slack or WhatsApp), a short weekly meeting and a demo every two-week cycle.

faq-suporte.a: We offer support plans with monitoring, fixes and ongoing improvement. We can also train your team to take the system over.

faq-dados.q: How do you handle personal data?
faq-dados.a: We follow Brazil's LGPD: we collect the minimum needed, document how data is processed, and apply access control and encryption in the systems we build. When needed, we sign a data processing agreement.

faq-idioma.q: Do you work with companies outside Brazil?
faq-idioma.a: Yes, in Portuguese and English, with meetings in a time zone that works for both sides.
